title: Quality, Compliance & Technical Governance

canonicalTerminology.definition: A quality management system is a coordinated set of processes used to direct and control an organisation with regard to quality objectives and controlled outputs.

claims.text: Railway technical compliance requires evidence that applicable requirements, responsibilities, records, changes and verification activities are controlled and traceable.
claims.applicabilityNote: Level-neutral educational statement; adapt depth without changing the canonical fact.

prohibitedUnsupportedClaims: Do not invent approvals, certificates, conformity status or audit evidence.
Do not present classroom quality records as formal compliance evidence.
